verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party rules engine where a user defines event conditions that automatically trigger actions inside Airwallex. Webhooks push event notifications to your own application, so they are a developer building block for building such automation, not the capability itself. Recurring invoices and subscriptions are fixed schedules, and AgentOS skills are workflows that an agent invokes, not event-triggered rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Webhooks enable Airwallex to send instant, real-time push notifications to your application when events occur in your Airwallex account.
